typography.sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

shadows.policy: hairline borders first; shadows only for overlays

must: Keep the belief, evidence, context inspector, and timeline in one reading column
Use real ledger records and live updates
Preserve keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior

decisions: Match alhinai.dev: Inter, warm paper surfaces, teal accent, hairline borders, Title Case section headings
Use a single 720px reading column instead of a three-column session workspace
Structure every mission as identity, current belief, belief change, outcome, comparison, and timeline
Make the real belief transition the primary explanatory visual
Treat the timeline as a quiet list without node rails
Group each tool call with its result as one activity row
Attach supporting evidence to the belief it changed instead of duplicating it in the summary
Label estimated token counts and unused retrieval stages explicitly
Use restrained teal only for live, current, and successful states
